name: Machu Picchu + Sacred Valley 2D/1N
description: Combine the majesty of the Sacred Valley with the unique experience of Machu Picchu. A complete journey that includes the main archaeological sites of the Sacred Valley and a guided visit to the citadel of Machu Picchu.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley VIP + Train to Aguas Calientes
activities: Visit to Chinchero and its artisan center
Evening train from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes
Overnight in accommodation in Aguas Calientes

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu + Return to Cusco
activities: Breakfast at the hotel in Aguas Calientes
Bus ride up to Machu Picchu
Free time to explore and take photos
Return by bus to Aguas Calientes
Time for lunch and strolling in the town
Transfer by tourist transport to Cusco (arrival approx. 10:00 pm)

includes: Buses up and down to Machu Picchu
Lunch (1 – buffet in the Sacred Valley)
not_included: Dinner on day 1 in Aguas Calientes
Salt mines entrance (S/ 15 nationals – S/ 20 foreigners)

price_options.description: Transportation, guide, Expedition train, Machu Picchu entrance, bus, 1 night hotel, 1 breakfast and 1 buffet lunch
Includes the above with better train category and superior hotel
Exclusive mobility, private guide and accommodation of choice

optional_services.service: 3★ or 4★ hotel accommodation in Aguas Calientes
Entrance to Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain (subject to availability)

additional_info: The train departs from Ollantaytambo in the afternoon of day 1 and returns on day 2 in the evening
Machu Picchu entrance is during 07:00 am – 12:00 pm hours approx.
The tour does not include dinner in Aguas Calientes, but there are multiple restaurants available
It is recommended to buy tickets in advance, especially during high season

faq.question: Does the tour include lunch at Machu Picchu?
faq.answer: No, the included lunch is on day 1 (buffet in the Sacred Valley).

faq.question: Where do we spend the night?
Does this tour include entrances to all Sacred Valley archaeological sites?
faq.answer: No, the Tourist Ticket and Salt mines entrance must be purchased separately.
